title: Emissions below the operator-elicited minimum level are dropped before serialisation
asA: operator sizing log volume for a production environment
iWant: emissions below the minimum level to be dropped without serialising them
soThat: log volume matches the operator's chosen signal budget and the level filter is honoured line-by-line

acceptanceCriteria.description: With the elicited minimum level set to info, an emission at trace or debug produces no stdout line; an emission at info, warn, error or fatal produces one stdout line each.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application with minimum level set to info
acceptanceCriteria.when: one emission is issued at each of the six levels
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line count equals 4 (info, warn, error, fatal), and no line at trace or debug appears
